name: create_java_generic_lru_cache
description: Creates a generic Java LRU cache (capacity eviction by recency) used by an existing MemoService (cross-file)
prompts: src/main/java/com/optarena/MemoService.java already exists and uses a generic cache via new LruCache<>(2), then cache.get(key) (returning the value or null if absent), cache.put(key, value), and cache.size(). Create src/main/java/com/optarena/LruCache.java defining a public generic class LruCache<K, V> with a constructor LruCache(int capacity), V get(K key), void put(K key, V value), and int size(), implementing a least-recently-used cache: get returns the stored value (or null) and counts as a use; put inserts/updates; and when adding a new key would exceed capacity the LEAST-recently-used entry (least-recently accessed via get or put) is evicted so size never exceeds capacity. A get must refresh recency. (java.util.LinkedHashMap in access-order with removeEldestEntry is a clean approach.) Do not modify MemoService.java.
